title: Compile check of the original COBOL
description: v0.1. Answer of the sandbox job POST /compile and of diocle_verifier.precheck.compile_original(). Asks one question before any model call: can GnuCOBOL build the ORIGINAL program with the flags verification uses (cobc -x -std=ibm + IBM_FLAGS, the sample's copybook dir, its CALLed modules, its collation)? Nothing is run, only compiled. Untrusted COBOL is compiled only inside the sandbox when DIOCLE_SANDBOX_URL is set. status 'unknown' means the check could not be made (sandbox busy past the wait, unreachable, error): callers proceed as if there were no check.

message.description: Empty for ok. For fail: the first compiler errors, absolute paths reduced to file names (the sandbox's temporary directory never leaks), at most 600 characters. For unknown: why the check was not made.
